address: 3700 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103

zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP tables are the closest group to the stage, best when you want facial detail and the strongest small-club feel.

zones.label: Preferred
zones.description: Preferred is the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick: centered in the room, close enough for expressions and crowd work without needing the very nearest tables.

zones.label: GA
zones.description: GA keeps you in the main room with a clear sightline and is a strong value choice in an intimate comedy club.

zones.label: GA 2
zones.description: GA 2 runs along the outer side of the room. You trade some centering for a lower-cost seat while still staying in a compact 300-seat club.
